job.job_description:
Key Skills: Python, Generative AI (GenAI), Large Language Models (LLMs), OpenAI APIs, Prompt Engineering, AI Applications, API Development, LLM Orchestration, Machine Learning, Data Engineering

Roles & Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy GenAI and LLM-powered applications.
Build AI solutions using Python and modern Generative AI frameworks.
Integrate OpenAI APIs and implement reliable inference workflows.
Develop and optimize prompts to improve model performance and accuracy.
Build scalable API-based services for AI-driven applications.
Implement LLM orchestration and agent-based workflows.
Evaluate and test new LLM models through experimentation and benchmarking.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues in AI applications and production environments.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and data teams to deliver AI solutions.
Document solution designs, experiments, and best practices.

Experience Required:

6.1 - 10 years of experience in software development and AI/ML solutions.
Strong programming experience in Python.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Experience integrating and working with OpenAI APIs.
Strong understanding of prompt engineering techniques.
Experience building and deploying AI-powered applications.
Knowledge of LLM orchestration, agents, and AI workflows.
Experience developing scalable APIs and backend services.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Data Engineering experience is an added advantage.

Education: Any Graduation
